title: Expose issue timestamps (createdAt) in cam issue list --json + list output
description: cam issue list / --json carries no timestamp, so the orchestrator can only proxy recency by id number (fragile: hand-filed ids, demotes, cross-list). Surface a createdAt (ISO 8601, ideally also updatedAt) per issue in cam issue list --json (primary consumer = orchestrator), sourced from the issue file metadata; add+backfill the schema field if absent. Optional compact date column in the human-readable list. Additive field, must not break existing JSON consumers; covered by a test asserting the field is present and well-formed. Refine via /cam-spec before planning.

spec.scope: Expose the already-present, required createdAt of each issue in cam issue list --json output rows. Purely additive to the BacklogJsonRow output contract: no schema change and no backfill (createdAt is already required and present on all 283 issues). The human-readable list column and updatedAt are out of scope (separate issues).
acceptanceCriteria: BacklogJsonRow (src/issues/list.ts:158-163) gains a createdAt: string field, and toJsonRow (src/issues/list.ts:188-190) emits issue.createdAt for every row.
createdAt (ISO 8601, sourced verbatim from IssueEntry.createdAt at src/issues/types.ts:44) appears on every row in the plannable and byStage arrays of cam issue list --json.

The exact-shape test assertions are updated to include createdAt: test/issues/list.test.ts:348 and :356; test/issue-list.test.ts row toEquals at :394,:396-397,:442,:494 (and the top-level Object.keys().sort() assertion at :391 if row-key-order coverage requires it).
No schema change and no backfill: createdAt is already required (scripts/cam/issues.schema.json) and present on 100% of issue files; the value is passed through, not synthesized at read time.
The human-readable cam issue list output is unchanged (date column is out of scope, tracked separately).
bun run typecheck, bun test, bun run check:all all green.
gotchas: Tests assert row shape with toEqual and the top-level shape with Object.keys(parsed).sort() (test/issue-list.test.ts:391); the additive field WILL fail them until updated. Update them in the same change.
createdAt is a required non-optional field on IssueEntry (src/issues/types.ts:44); no optional-guarding needed, but keep it a plain passthrough (do not compute or default it).
Only the --json path (deriveBacklogJson/toJsonRow) changes; do NOT touch the human-readable renderer. No non-test module consumes BacklogJsonRow, so the output contract change is safe.
